newsitem.title: USA: Goleta to merge with Los Robles.
newsitem.headline: Goleta to merge with Los Robles.

text.p: Goleta National Bank said Wednesday it had signed a letter of intent to merge with Los Robles Bancorp to create a multibank holding company, Community West Bancshares.
Goleta National Bank and Los Robles Bank, a subsidiary of Los Robles Bancorp, will be the first two member-bank subsidiaries of Community West.
Under the deal, Goleta shareholders will receive about 0.55 share of Community West for each share of Goleta.
Outstanding warrants of Goleta will be exchanged for warrants in Community West at the same ratio.
Goleta has about 1.47 million shares outstanding.
Goleta said that based on the last closing price for Los Robles stock of $18.25, the transaction is valued at about $14.8 million.
Los Robles Bancorp's name will be changed to Community West Bancshares.
Michael Alexander, chairman of Goleta, will become chairman of Community West. Jerry Miller, chairman of Los Robles Bancorp, will become vice chairman of Community West.

Goleta President and Chief Executive Lew Stone will become president and chief executive of the new holding company, and Robert Hamilton, president and chief executive of Los Robles Bancorp, will become executive vice president of Community West.

The letter of intent, subject to the preparation and execution of a definitive agreement, requires approval by shareholders of both Goleta and Los Robles as well as state and federal regulatory agencies.
Goleta said it expects the tax-free-exchange, pooling-of-interests transaction to be completed during the 1997 fourth quarter.
Los Robles Bank is a community bank with 1996 year-end assets of $93.5 million. Goleta National Bank is a community bank with 1996 year-end assets of $80.9 million.
